Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms_te: Small black water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit.

moderate: Spray copper oxychloride 50% WP at 3 g per litre of water.

how_to_spray_te: Wear gloves, a mask over nose and mouth, goggles and a long-sleeved shirt.
Measure the chemical exactly with a measuring cup. Too much harms the crop and you.
First mix it in a little water in a small bucket, then pour into the tank, fill with water and mix well.
Spray in the morning or evening when there is little wind. Do not spray against the wind.
Spray a fine mist so both the upper and lower sides of the leaves get wet.
Do not spray if rain is expected within 4-6 hours.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying.
Bathe with soap afterwards. Break and bury empty containers; keep them away from children and animals.
Always follow the waiting days before harvest (PHI) printed on the label.
